body: In 40 of 2,837 funk songs (1.4%), mostly in chorus and verse sections; mostly in major keys: use the project's key in major, or its relative minor if that's what the project is in, and read the numerals there.

A loop of 3 chords, written from the tonic when it's in it (songs start it anywhere). Numerals follow the key's own scale (natural minor in minor keys); b and # mark roots outside it. A bar per chord; change the rhythm and voicing to suit the part.
From user-written chord charts, with each song's key estimated: frequent progressions are reliable, rarer ones less so.
